title: Qbar-l proper base change
statement:
Let $f:X\to Y$ be proper, let $g:Y'\to Y$ be arbitrary, and let
$K\in\Dbc(X,\Qlb)$. The descended exchange transformation of
[prop-weil-pbc-descent-functors] is an isomorphism
$$
 Lg^*Rf_*K\xrightarrow{\sim}Rf'_*Lg'^*K
 \quad\text{in }\Dbc(Y',\Qlb).
$$
If $K$ is represented by a pair $(E,K_E)$ with $K_E\in\Dbc(X,E)$, this map
is represented after a finite overfield $M$ by the $M$-coefficient exchange
isomorphism of [thm-weil-pbc-finite-extension] applied to $T_{M/E}K_E$. The
result is independent of $E$, $M$, and the representative.

note:
*Source note:* at each finite stage this is Stacks Project, Pro-etale
Cohomology, Theorem 61.30.1 ([Tag
09C9](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/09C9)), applied with
$\Lambda=\mathcal O_E$: a proper base-change isomorphism for a derived
complete $K$ whose reductions are bounded below and of etale origin. What
the blueprint adds is the statement on the $\Qlb$ coefficient category
$\Dbc(Y',\Qlb)$, obtained by descent from the finite-stage isomorphisms
along the scalar extensions $T_{F/E}$, together with the independence of the
stage and of the representative.

proof.text: Write $A_E=Lg_E^*Rf_{*,E}$ and $B_E=Rf\prime_{*,E}Lg\prime_E^*$ and let $c_E:A_E\to B_E$ be the finite-stage exchange transformation. By [prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension], its scalar extension, after the specified comparison isomorphisms, is $c_M$ for $E\subset M$. Thus [prop-weil-pbc-descent-functors] descends this family to $c:A\to B$ on $\Dbc(-,\Qlb)=\mathcal P_{-}$ of [def-weil-pbc-qbar-category]. At $(E,K_E)$ its component is represented at $E$ by $c_E(K_E)$; at $M\supset E$ it is represented by $c_M(T_{M/E}K_E)$ with the same comparison isomorphisms.

By [thm-weil-pbc-finite-extension], $c_E(K_E)$ has an inverse $d_E$ because $f$ is proper and the square is cartesian; there is no extra restriction on $g$. Regard $d_E$ as a morphism class at stage $E$. By [def-weil-pbc-finite-stage-pair-category], identities and composites of these classes are computed at $E$. Hence $[E,d_E]\circ[E,c_E(K_E)]=[E,\mathrm{id}]$ and $[E,c_E(K_E)]\circ[E,d_E]=[E,\mathrm{id}]$. These equations give an inverse to the descended component. The common-stage equality criterion of [prop-weil-pbc-common-stage-calculus] gives the same equations if the component is written at a larger stage.

For two overfields $M,N\supset E$, choose a common finite overfield $P$. The scalar compatibility in [prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension] identifies both transported exchange maps with $c_P(T_{P/E}K_E)$; the equivalence relation of [def-weil-pbc-finite-stage-pair-category] therefore identifies their classes. If another pair $(F,L_F)$ represents $K$ through an isomorphism $h:(E,K_E)\to(F,L_F)$, naturality of the descended transformation in [prop-weil-pbc-descent-functors] gives $B(h)\circ c_{(E,K_E)}=c_{(F,L_F)}\circ A(h)$. Since functors carry an inverse of $h$ to an inverse, this is precisely equality of the two maps after identifying their source and target with $A(K),B(K)$. Changing the morphism representative of $h$ leaves these classes unchanged by the same pair-category equivalence relation. This proves independence of $E$, the common stage, and the representative, without asserting that two different pairs are literally equal.

proof.text:
The scalar-compatible family of finite-extension exchange maps descends to a
natural transformation by [prop-weil-pbc-descent-functors]; at every finite
stage it is an isomorphism by [thm-weil-pbc-finite-extension], and the
descent formula preserves this property through the common-stage colimit of
[def-weil-pbc-qbar-category]. Independence of the representatives is the
independence statement of [thm-weil-pbc-finite-extension] together with the
equivalence relation of [def-weil-pbc-finite-stage-pair-category].

lean.statement: theorem qbar_properBaseChange [IsProper f] : ∃ P : PbcQbarExchangePresentation l Ω sq, (∀ K : pbcQbarCategory l Ω X, IsIso ((P.exchange).app K)) ∧ (∀ (M : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω) (K : pbcStageCategory l Ω X M), IsIso ((P.Ex.τ M).app K)) ∧ (∀ (K : pbcQbarCategory l Ω X) (M : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω) (h : K.stage ≤ M), (P.exchange).app K = PbcQbarExchangePresentation.atStage l Ω sq P K M h) ∧ (∀ (K L : pbcQbarCategory l Ω X) (h : K ≅ L), (P.Rf.base.functor ⋙ P.Lg.base.functor).map h.hom ≫ (P.exchange).app L = (P.exchange).app K ≫ (P.Lg'.base.functor ⋙ P.Rf'.base.functor).map h.hom)
